(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman is hiring an Associate Software Engineer or Software Engineer for its Strategic Deterrent Systems Division within Defense Systems. The role focuses on defining software system architecture, creating and tracing requirements, applying model-based systems engineering, and collaborating with software teams in an agile environment.
Associate Software Engineer / Software Engineer designing software-product architectures and tracing requirements using MBSE tools

Responsibilities:
• Design and define software system architecture for new or existing Software Products.Requirements creation and tracing to software
• Model-based System Engineering (MBSE) and associated tools (e.g., DOORS or Cameo)
• Work in an agile development environment
• Work with a team of software developers, other Software System Engineers and SME’s (subject matter experts)

Requirements:
• Be completing or has completed their bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
• Be majoring in or having majored in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Development or Aerospace Engineering
• Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
• Be completing or has completed their master's degree from an accredited institution
• Be majoring in or having majored in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Development or Aerospace Engineering
• Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Preferred:
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.70/4.0 or higher
• Previous internship/co-op or other work experience, leadership & teamwork capabilities, interpersonal communication skills, and activities (professional/community/extracurricular)
